maya: Quick async — we have a gap in the reservation plan for the week of 4/11. Need owners for ripcords/fallbacks, final CR review, and a canary window. @samir @linh can you confirm availability?

samir: Procurement owner here. Vendor (Rack32) updated ship ETA -> 2026-04-09 (noted in INF-4321). We can get 8 GPUs first wave, remainder delayed ~4 days. Will update INF-4321 with PO #PO-9832. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

linh: Runtime: we can accept staggered additions but need exact node counts & KV cache warmup plan. Can we do 8 nodes as first canary? Also need PR sign-off for autoscaler tweak (PR #4823). Pinged ryan for perf numbers.

ryan: ML: ran quick perf on q4_0 quant, 8-node canary looks fine for model-llama-large, p95 ~110ms, p99 ~210ms. Uploading perf log to ENG-ML/benchmarks. LGTM pending eng-platform review.

rachel: SRE: Tue 2026-04-12 02:00-05:00 PST works for canary. Need explicit rollback playbook and hard quota ceilings set before start.

maya: Rollback playbook (short):
1) capacity-bot cancel-reservation --id res-789
2) kubectl -n inference set image deployment/serving canary=hosted-v1-small
3) set autoscale min=1,max=4
4) alert on >5% errors -> trigger manual cutover to hosted

Example reserve command:
```
capacity-bot reserve --pool dedicated-gpu --count 8 --starts 2026-04-12T02:00:00Z --tag canary-4-12
```

capacity-bot: reservation queued (id=res-789) — owner=samir. ETA exec window scheduled 2026-04-12T02:00Z.

linh: Noted. I'll add KV cache migration steps to PR #4823 and flag the autoscaler change. Can someone with org perms add the calendar invite?

samir: I'll update INF-4321 with PO and set the calendar once capacity-bot confirms. Also adding ripcord routing: on failure, switch traffic to hosted-v1-small and reduce batch_size to 1.

maya: Thanks. Action items: samir -> update INF-4321 & calendar (EOD today); linh -> update PR #4823 with cache steps (EOD); rachel -> create rollback runbook checklist in SRE runbooks; ryan -> attach perf logs to PR. We'll confirm in #canaries channel after calendar is up. :thumbsup:
